Basic chat completion via the GitHub Copilot provider (gpt-4o) with a single user message

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"github_copilot/gpt-4o\",\"temperature\":0}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).message.content)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).finish_reason)
IO.inspect(result.model)
IO.inspect(result.usage.total_tokens)
```
